w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
firstContext: Static floods your senses — too much world, all at once. (-1 HP)
Elena waits two days at your fire, getting thinner. Nobody answers. They walk back to Stonebridge with nothing. They'll remember the silence.
📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
⚠ STARVING: health and energy falling. The spiral has started.
Village meal: +1000 kcal, +1L water from the communal pantry. (Half ration — they don't trust you yet.)

auditLine: ◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A lesser seat — global standing, waves 1–3 faced (13/10/6), with 3 wave-4 fought, 11 contests survived, 3 crises weathered. The table does not rise. It prices.
ledgerLine: The table has read your ledger. The protected outnumber the killed; the food truth was shared. The light road is open.
finalOutcomeLines: ◈ THE ARCHITECT — Sam Wilson ascended through doors you built: relay. The galaxy will remember the god's name. The village will remember who built the door. Both are true. Neither is small.

◈ THE PANTHEON — Ethan Hunt and Sam Wilson ascended together, and gods, it turns out, have politics. They argue about you the way the living argue about weather. Mostly, they agree: the village comes first. Mostly.

gotAwayLines: It got away. No meat, no trophy — but you're breathing, and now you know its moves.
